units.source_text: “喏，千重子，爸爸对树木不太在行，

en.t: Well, Chieko, your father does not know much about trees,

units.source_text: 但樟树是不是南国的树种，生长在气候温暖的地方呢？

en.t: but is the camphor tree a southern species, one that grows in places with a warm climate?

units.source_text: 热海和九州一带都盛产吧？

en.t: They must grow abundantly around Atami and throughout Kyushu, do they not?

units.source_text: 这里的樟树，虽说是老树，但令人感到好像是大盆景一样。”

en.t: The camphor tree here may be an old tree, but somehow it feels like a great big bonsai.
